items.text: On Linux, an image opened in a viewer pane shows the picture, zooms like the Mac's, and keeps the zoom across a save.
On Linux, git-status: and git-diff: panes show the diff with a changed-files panel, filter, change stepping and live refresh.
The Linux markdown viewer gets its table of contents card.
A Linux viewer pane shows a feedback button when its content lives in a git checkout.
viewer-feedback.sh waits quietly for its steps file; linux.md documents the feedback button.
WIP T3397: session-restore.sh covers an agent restart; ipc-server.sh I16 probes +set-banner now that +reload is served.
test/linux/session-restore.sh is executable like its siblings.
Relaunching the Linux app brings back its windows with every pane re-attached to its shell.
Fullscreen Claude Code blanks the pane on every resize, and the sync hold is what hides it.
The divider-drag perf test measures a real drag at 4 and 8 panes instead of reusing the 2-pane number.
